method: Visual inspection of contact-sheet frames at 5 and 20 seconds per master

genuine.status: No missing subject observed in sampled frames; source quality varies

fully_synthetic.status: Faces and generated mouth region visible; head/body outside animated area remain still

cloned.status: Intended subjects and mouth regions visible in sampled frames; no missing face or blank sampled frame observed. Lighting, microphone occlusion and source resolution vary.

limitations: Sampled frames do not establish continuous lip synchronization, absence of transient artifacts, accent or detector performance.
